catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class names an input-free source-output disable/safe-state command for a source measure unit. cap.device.configure.v1 is a write class and cannot serve as a safe-state action; the stop classes are motion/compute stops (cap.motion.stop.v1, cap.motion.estop.v1, cap.compute.cancel.v1) and do not describe this device.
catalogue_requests.summary: Turn a source measure unit output off and confirm the output state, as an input-free safe-state action.

notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/labs/qcodespp__qcodespp --backend fake; the evidence is contract_checked and never an MHS-Device level. No VISA session, QCoDeS, PyVISA or upstream code was imported or run, and the hardware backend was never opened. Authored by deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017 (a model, not a human); reviewed_by is null and no human reviewed or tested this package.

DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card names family qcodes and helper QcodesDriver for the entry symbol qcodespp.instrument_drivers.tektronix.Keithley_2450:Keithley_2450 (Keithley_2450.py:5). That class builds every Parameter with add_parameter (Keithley_2450.py:13-120), which the QcodesDriver source proof does not accept, so this package is a direct Driver over the same pinned class with native.py as the hardware factory and a source-shaped fake. It preserves the primary source/measure control: reads voltage (measured or source setpoint), current, resistance, output, source function, voltage compliance and current compliance; writes voltage, current, output, source, voltage compliance and current compliance through cap.device.configure.v1; the safe-state action is x-cap.qcodespp.output_off.v1. The clone is clean at the pinned commit 77090fc8f3ece9831887c8a07bd1249d343d18c1.

Limits: no text in the clone states a voltage, current or compliance bound, so voltage, current, compliancev and compliancei are Limit.operator_required (Keithley_2450.py:37-47, 49-73, 136-171); site-limits.example.json is an example operator overlay only, not a device bound. The voltage and current writes require the output on and select the matching source function through _set_mode_and_sense when needed; a write with the output off is refused MHS.DEVICE.PRECONDITION_UNMET before any mode change. The measurement reads check :OUTP:STAT? first and return no value while the output is off instead of propagating the upstream RuntimeError, so the state stays readable in the safe state; they never report a cached measurement. Single-value setpoint replies are parsed as float and multi-field READ? replies use the upstream _volt_parser, _curr_parser and _resistance_parser (Keithley_2450.py:125-183, 231-242).

Safety: risk R2 because the source can drive voltage and current into an external circuit and a wrong level or compliance can be high-energy; no R3 high-voltage claim is made because no clone text states a voltage capability. The independent stop is the input-free safe-state action x-cap.qcodespp.output_off.v1, which writes :OUTP:STAT 0 (the upstream output Parameter's setter command, Keithley_2450.py:93-96) and confirms :OUTP:STAT? reports the output off; the @estop method writes the same command and the runtime latches. This is a software command to the instrument, not a hardware e-stop; estop_physical_ref is not claimed. An e-stop sends the output-off command twice (the @estop and then the safe-state action), which is idempotent. A malformed :OUTP:STAT? readback and a failed native write were tested through the actual e-stop path; both give failed MHS.SAFETY.SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED with the latch held.

NOT COVERED: rangev_source, rangev_sense, rangei_source, rangei_sense, nplcv, nplci and fourwiresense (ordinary range/integration settings, Keithley_2450.py:13-35, 88-91, 98-108); reset/:*RST (it changes device state, Keithley_2450.py:218-229); the QCoDeS validators and value wrappers (the driver calls the source-visible methods and commands directly); the upstream instrument's timing, auto-range, SCPI error queue and output relay behavior; and the other three entry classes of the driver pack (Model_340, MercuryiPS_120, AttocubeAMC100) are out of scope for this one-device package. Mock strategy: the card prefers upstream-sim and hints at instrument_mocks.py, but those classes are generic QCoDeS test doubles (MockParabola, DummyInstrument), not a simulation of the Keithley 2450 and not a subclass of the selected class; the package therefore uses a source-shaped package fake. Fake fidelity: initial state values are placeholders marked # placeholder in fake.py (source CURR, sense VOLT, output on, 1.0 V, 1 mA, 10 V voltage compliance, 0.1 A current compliance); the fake does not model timing, auto-range, compliance/range rounding, the SCPI error queue, the output relay or the QCoDeS validators, so a first supervised hardware run must exercise both source modes, both compliances and the output-off readback. native.py constructs the pinned QCoDeS instrument with an operator-supplied VISA address; its constructor opens the session, adds Parameters and calls connect_message but does not turn the output on. Nothing was run on hardware.

Gate notes: the only findings are G7.MAYBE_ABSENT for ask, write and close, which the class inherits from QCoDeS VisaInstrument outside the clone; no G4 warnings. The extension safe-state action is requested in catalogue_requests because no catalogue class expresses an input-free source-output disable for an SMU.

MODEL REVIEW (gpt-6.1-sol, a model and not a human, 2026-11-17; reviewed_by stays null): Model review confirmed the pinned source and software output-off readback but found that output enable and source-mode changes bypass all numeric operator_required limits, while scalar sensing replies are mislabeled as resistance. driver.py conservatively raises risk from R2 to R3, facts.md records the hazards and missing enable/re-enable and reply-format contracts, and test_driver.py adds three blocking regressions without changing the stock gate assertion. reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json were regenerated; the final gate fails G9 on exactly those three regressions, and the strict collector reports RESULT_UNTRUSTED because the preserved author RESULT.json still says pass. Keep the package blocked for a source-backed redesign rather than accepting the initial passing fake contract. For the human reviewer: QUARANTINE is the package blocker for the reproduced envelope bypass and unsupported resistance conversion. With no overlay, output=true and source=VOLT complete against stored levels; level writes also switch mode before writing the requested level. An explicit bounded enable/re-enable design and verified sensing-reply format are needed before unblocking. Output-off status is not an independent physical stop or a discharge measurement. Lakeshore Model_340, MercuryiPS_120 and AttocubeAMC100 are excluded. The proposed direct-driver/python-object override describes package shape only and does not resolve these blockers.
